basics.name: Gael Monein
basics.label: Fullstack Software Engineer
basics.summary: Fullstack Software Engineer with 6+ years’ experience specializing in Ruby on Rails and React. Driven by continuous learning and simplification to ship elegant, maintainable, unit-tested solutions.

work.name: My Job Glasses
highlights: Led architecture design in a team of 3 engineers building the mobile application.
Built a back-office for customer success, sales and operations, automating 30+ tasks monthly.
Supported scalability and fixed critical issues on a legacy monolith handling 200→2000 appointments/week.

work.name: 42 Network
highlights: Maintained intranet, exams, and internal tools in a Kanban team of 5.
Trained 4 volunteers/interns on web development tools.
Developed a platform to manage candidate registrations for 42 Piscines.

projects.name: Migrate APIs to GraphQL
projects.summary: Replaced JSON:API with GraphQL, maintained 90%+ coverage, and migrated frontend to TypeScript/Apollo.
highlights: Converted JSON:API to GraphQL, keeping code coverage at 90%+ with GraphQL RSpec.
Documented APIs and flows for mobile team (Docusaurus).
Implemented Pundit authorizations in GraphQL API.
Migrated JS + Redux to TS + Apollo.

projects.name: Monitoring Stack + Optimization
projects.summary: Eliminated N+1 queries and slashed deployment time from 8 min to 1 min.
highlights: Fixed critical N+1 queries and built unit-test catchers.
Improved deployment speed from 8 minutes to 1 minute (Docker, Kubernetes).

projects.name: Extract Meetings Programs from the Monolith
projects.summary: Built a new Rails/React service for meeting programs and migrated data.
highlights: Built a second Rails/React app to manage meeting programs.
Developed account-management UI (React, GraphQL).
Created services to migrate marketplace data into PostgreSQL.
Computed global metrics for projects and participations.

projects.name: Poker Data Mining
projects.summary: Reverse-engineered a poker platform, parsed hand data, and surfaced exploitable game insights.
highlights: Instrumented application to extract table data from memory (C, Python).
Parsed and reconstructed poker hands from WebSocket streams.
Built analytics app to highlight exploitable games (Ruby, Sinatra, Go).
Reverse-engineered private WebSocket API and built connector.

projects.name: Optimize Intranet and APIs
projects.summary: Dramatically reduced DB CPU and API response times through partitioning and monitoring.
highlights: Reduced DB CPU usage from 80% to 30% (PostgreSQL).
Decreased API response times from 800 ms to 200 ms.
Split a 400 M+ row table into yearly partitions.
Configured and deployed PostgreSQL replicas.
